$comment: The to-do list on /admin/seo. The Saturday run (/seo-weekly) writes this file: new tasks added, status updated, never an id reused. Every task has why, steps and expect. Hannes's tasks carry minutes; their sum per week stays under rules.owner_minutes_per_week in config.json.

items.task: Give the SEO loop access to deutschtest-ueben.de in Search Console
items.why: Without it every Google number on this page is unknown. This site gets its own Google Cloud project and service account, separate from the Dutch sites.
steps: Search Console > deutschtest-ueben.de > Settings > Users and permissions > Add user.
Email: the service account from seo-agent/google-api-access.md (claude-seo-reader@deutschtest-seo.iam.gserviceaccount.com), permission: Full.
GitHub > this repo > Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > New repository secret: GSC_SA_JSON = the whole JSON key file.
Vercel > project > Environment variables: the same GSC_SA_JSON for Production, so this page can read Search Console live.
items.expect: The next Friday run writes gsc.json with data, and this page shows Google live within a minute of the Vercel redeploy.

items.task: Run the Friday data pull once by hand
items.why: The first snapshot and the page triage have to exist before the Saturday routine has anything to read.
steps: GitHub > Actions > "SEO snapshot (Friday evening)" > Run workflow, with backfill ticked once GSC access is in.
Or locally: node scripts/seo-agent/collect.mjs && node scripts/seo-agent/pages.mjs && node scripts/seo-agent/score.mjs, then commit seo-agent/.
items.expect: seo-agent/data/<week>/ appears on main and this page shows the site structure with a score.

items.task: Add the site to Bing Webmaster Tools and set BING_API_KEY
items.why: ChatGPT search leans on Bing, and Bing is the control group when Google drops: if Bing holds, the site is fine and Google changed its mind.
steps: bing.com/webmasters > Add site > import from Search Console (fastest).
Settings > API access > generate a key; add it as the GitHub secret BING_API_KEY (and on Vercel for the live tile).
items.expect: The Bing tile fills from the next Friday run.

items.task: Confirm the competitor domains in seo-agent/config.json
items.why: CLAUDE.md names TestGerman, Plakos and Preparaio; the domains in config.json are a guess until you check them. The Firecrawl map only runs with FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
steps: Open seo-agent/config.json > competitors and correct the three domains.
Add FIRECRAWL_API_KEY (free tier: 1,000 credits a month, about 3 a week needed) if you want the weekly new-pages diff.
items.expect: competitors.json lists each site's URL count and what they added since last week.
